chapter: Working with Duke and final reflections
title: Religion and disasters
summary: Whaley says he intends to tell colleagues at the Guild that God gave his son to save people, and laments those lost in floods.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: They were talking about all these people getting killed -- remember? Had the plane crash and the floods, earthquakes.
I said to myself, next time they bring that up, I'm gonna tell them --well, the Lord gave his only begotten son for the people to save the people.
He gave his son, see, and he was
crucified, dead and buried for our sins.
I'll tell you one thing about that -- talk about saving all those people, it's a shame those people were washed away.
